name: FavaBench
description: FavaBench is an evaluation benchmark for automatic fine-grained hallucination detection in language model outputs, containing about one thousand human judgments across various domains to assess different types of hallucinations.
reputation: A relatively new, niche benchmark that is cited as a useful testbed for fine-grained hallucination detection, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Includes fine-grained human judgments on hallucinations; supports training retrieval-augmented models for detection and correction.
